authorization: PM explicitly requests continuing research loop/new ideas on 2026-10-21; does not reopen original experiment
historical_data_status: All historical dates were accessible/known during first-wave work; new adaptive hypotheses make all this historical evidence exploratory

multiscale_trend.rule: daily mean(sign trailing returns), positive part only; target20% annual volatility from last20 completed daily returns, max75% BTC; 5pp rebalance band; no borrowing

confirmed_pullback.rule: prior4H downside shock relative to preceding30bar return volatility excluding shock; next4H up-close and higher/equal low; daily close above120daymean; optional volume>=preceding30median; 50% weight; prior14ATR*2 stop; exit20barmean/12bars/dailyfilter

pending_policy: first immutable intent wins until execution, ttl12h; lagged intents are NOT moved forward by new signals
liquidity_policy: zero-volume hour: no orders/stops fills, retain until TTL; gap stops fill first positive-volume bar at adverse open/stop plus costs
selection_policy: No selecting best variant: primaries T0/R0 fixed before results. All variants are sensitivity trials. Controls evaluated with same cash/cost rules
qualification: historical_screen_pass only shortlists; research_qualified=False until truly prospective net risk/cost evidence and cross-batch selection audit; demo_ready=False until account/risk/execution gates
prospective_policy: No fabricated future PnL. First freeze after current turn uses next fully unobserved UTC bar; build observational no-order forward ledger before calling prospective performance
stop_policy: No search expansion within cohort, no new winners by changed gates; future batches preregistered separately, cumulative ledger retained
